image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of used baseballs. The balls are tightly packed, filling the frame. They show signs of wear, including scuff marks and dirt stains on the white leather. The characteristic red stitching is visible on most balls, though some seams are partially obscured by the angle or other balls. At the bottom edge, there is a line of garbled, nonsensical text that appears to be an AI generation artifact.

artifact_observations.reasoning: A line of nonsensical, garbled characters resembling text is present at the very bottom. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model attempts to render text but fails to produce legible letters.

The red stitching lacks the fine detail of individual threads. In many places, the stitches merge into smooth red ribbons or blobs, losing the distinct 'double stitch' structure defined in the taxonomy.
Some boundaries between adjacent baseballs are soft or slightly fused. The depth separation is ambiguous in areas where balls overlap, suggesting a lack of rigorous geometric grounding.
The elliptical projection of the seam on the upper-right ball seems slightly inconsistent with the spherical geometry of its neighbors, appearing subtly warped.
